visible_moments: 0-4s: oversized two-eye mascot and colorful character cascade
4-8s: small vertical team stack with product announcement
8-11s: rotated mascot settles into Grok Bot wordmark
11-17s: chat window receives a real task and acknowledges it
17-21s: connected tools appear and work is delegated
21-27s: camera widens to parallel specialist panels

structure: Multiply into a color-coded specialist team
Reveal tool connections in a stagger
Expand the same workspace into parallel task lanes
camera_and_motion: scale and rotate the mascot before a stable brand hold
retain the same UI identity through a continuous zoom-out and return
give key copy at least two seconds to read
negative_constraints: no invented numerical claims beyond the reference
no unrelated checkout or city scenes

prompt_defaults.subject: Grok Bot and a color-coded team of specialist assistants
prompt_defaults.setting: a near-white 16:9 canvas with a minimalist chat workspace
prompt_defaults.primary_action: a user delegates a request, assistants connect tools, work in parallel, and return completed outcomes
prompt_defaults.camera_move: mascot scale reveal followed by a continuous workspace zoom-out and return
prompt_defaults.lighting: flat graphic color without lighting simulation
prompt_defaults.mood: clear, playful opening and calm useful product demonstration

prompt_variants.purpose: Test shape identity, controlled motion and character multiplication without typography.
prompt_variants.prompt: A 5-second 16:9 flat 2D motion graphic on a clean near-white background. A centered solid black circular mascot has exactly two vertical white pill-shaped eyes, no mouth, no limbs. It tilts 15 degrees and smoothly scales down. Three simple cyan, golden-yellow and mint-green two-eye silhouettes arrive one after another and settle into a small vertical team stack at center. Crisp vector-like edges, flat colors, fixed camera, generous empty space. Preserve exactly two eyes on every character. No text, no gradients, no shadows, no realistic objects. Finish on a stable stack.

prompt_variants.purpose: Reusable deterministic plan with replaceable brand, user request, tools, specialists and verified outcomes.
prompt_variants.prompt: Build a 32.53-second 16:9 SaaS demo. 0-8s: animate a two-eye brand mascot into a color-coded team, then announce the product. 8-11s: settle the source brand mark beside the editable brand name. 11-17s: reveal an app window, a concrete user request and a short acknowledgement. 17-21s: stagger the connected-tool labels and a delegation response. 21-27s: transform the same app into a four-panel specialist workspace; reveal task progress independently. 27-30s: return to the main panel and check off verified results. 30-32.53s: hold the brand lockup. Use HTML text, explicit timeline beats and flat source-inspired graphics; never synthesize UI text as video pixels. Replace brand, request, tools, lanes and results from the new use case.
